## Result

- Skill: delivery-review.
- Review status: changes-requested.
- Package members: primary plan — docs/plans/2026-09-10-release-validation-integration.md.
- Upstream review ID: design-review-r1; explicit user-selected correction to existing Release direction, no new Proposal Review selected.
- Review ID and round: delivery-review-r1, round1.
- Traceability result: one missing main-path allocation under REL-SR-08/09/22/24; otherwise bounded one-milestone sequence and final checkpoint coherent.
- Material findings: rvi-delivery-f1.
- Correction targets: primary plan, owning stage plan.
- Recording status: recorded upon successful targeted save.
- Open blockers: none requiring an upstream decision; required plan correction remains.
- Immediate next stage: plan-owned correction, then independent reassessment.
- Claim limitations: no implementation authority, runtime/CI pass, Verify, PR or publication readiness.

## Independent full-plan assessment

The reviewer authored none of the Design, plan or engineering. Read the complete primary plan, current exact Design approval/member map, Release amendment, prior four-failure evidence and actual selector/runner/builder interfaces. Prior release-only content review and failure diagnosis were assessments, not authorship. Exact Design subjects match. No plan, engineering, activity or work entry is edited or initialized.

A single M1 is proportionate for this shared integration correction: regression first, exact isolated candidate preparation, selected checks on actual prepared source/package, current-fixture reconciliation and full actual new-version proof. It preserves original checkout, historical/incompatible populations and independent final review followed by distinct Verify. The existing builder supplies concrete C/overlay/tarball identity and a full checker, so this is feasible without fabricated metadata or another runner. Invalid intent/source, failed preparation and stale package checks remain required under the approved model; CLI/npm negative suites must remain executed, not subsumed by a receipt with narrower coverage. External-only substitution and no publication authority remain appropriate.

The observed four failed ordinary checks remain the red integration baseline, not dismissed because the candidate passed. The plan correctly requires explicit prepared-subject reporting and retains historical validation. However, the actual main graph is a separate admitted entry path that its selected-only allocation does not cover adequately. This is a bounded plan gap, not a Design ambiguity or permission to waive main checks. All other unchanged Release approval, immutable publication and recovery policy remains outside the correction.

## Material finding

- Finding ID: rvi-delivery-f1.
- Severity: major (required admitted CI path lacks concrete allocation).
- Scope: artifact-local.
- Affected artifact: registered primary plan docs/plans/2026-09-10-release-validation-integration.md.
- Owning stage: plan.
- Location: M1 steps2/4 and Requirements and proof command allocation.
- Evidence: The approved Release section explicitly covers ordinary PR and main CI. The primary plan allocates ordinary selected CI and only names ci.sh --mode pr for actual final proof. In scripts/ci.sh, main dispatches run_direct_product_gates, bypassing run_selected_mode; that direct graph runs root npm tests and push-main lifecycle validation and therefore retains the same unprepared-source hazards unless integrated explicitly. PR selected-path success cannot establish the admitted main path.
- Required outcome: Allocate M1 implementation and proof to both PR selected and main direct entry paths, preserving their required checks and failure propagation. Name feasible actual main integration proof or a shared-composition proof with direct main dispatch regression that establishes the same prepared subject, identity reporting and fail-closed behavior. Retain final PR-range proof and independent final review/Verify. No new product behavior or runner is required.
- Safe resolution path: plan author adds bounded main/direct integration and proof, reviewer reassesses revised exact plan; implementation follows only current approval.
- needs-decision rationale: none; approved Design already selects both paths.

## Checks and handoff

Actually performed complete plan read, Design review/subject comparison, scoped primary context, actual ci.sh dispatch/direct/selected graph inspection, selector historical command and existing candidate-boundary reads, and targeted recording. No new runtime experiment was needed to establish the routing difference; earlier observed failures remain evidence of the underlying subject mismatch, not proof that unimplemented integration works. Record-store validation and diff checks follow save. Return to plan owner; preserve original review and finding. No GitHub review-count or npm setup action is taken or inferred by this assessment.
